title: Eclipse Business Manager
summary: Invoicing, dues, stock and agent commissions for an innerwear brand supplying stores across Tamil Nadu.
problem: Every store dispatch was billed by hand. GST and non-GST invoices, size-wise pricing, part payments and returns made it slow and error-prone, and nobody had a clear view of who owed what.
solution: Started as an invoice manager and grew over three years into the brand's daily system: GST and non-GST invoices, customer ledgers, cash entries, stock, orders, price lists, agent commissions and a phone app for the marketing team.

features.title: GST and non-GST invoices
features.description: Multi-item, size-wise invoices with discounts, round-off and print or PDF.

features.title: Customer ledgers and dues
features.description: Outstanding and overdue invoices per store, updated with every payment or return.

features.title: Stock and orders
features.description: Stock levels and movements, and orders that turn into invoices.

features.title: Agent commission
features.description: Agents tagged to stores earn a monthly commission on what was actually collected.

features.title: Price templates
features.description: Saved GST and non-GST price lists, with bulk adjust and print.

features.title: Roles and mobile app
features.description: Installable app; marketing staff see only customers and ledgers for their route.

features.title: Reports
features.description: Product-by-size sales, collection summary and customer reports.

aiNote: AI generated the first invoice templates and GST edge-case tests, and later the 40+ backend tests for the roles and permissions rollout.
results: Invoices in minutes instead of a long manual process
